text:
alice: Heads-up — planning an edge delta shift in us-west-2 for router v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 during the 14:00 PT change window. Goal: gradual traffic shift 0% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m soak between steps. I’ll kick off canary after preflight. Please ack and call out any pinned tenants. :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy action 'edge-delta-190123' queued. Will post progress updates.

ben: preflight checks done (14:00:10). Health probes ok, p90 latency +2ms, alloc/heap stable. No increased 5xx in last 30m. :thumbsup:

carmen: pinned customer acct-42 to v3.2.0 for the window (routing rule: tenant=acct-42 -> version=v3.2.0). I pushed the pin to the config store.

samqa: QA smoke ran against canary instance. Basic chat flows + embeddings look fine. Noted minor tokenization diff but no functional regressions.

ryan: oncall here. Alerts are set: infra-alerts/rtr-p50-latency (>10ms) and infra-alerts/rtr-5xx-rate (>0.5%). I’ll be watching logs and tracing.

deploy-bot: canary shift started -> router-edge-usw2-canary -> weight=10%. (action id: edge-delta-190123-canary)

ben: saw a small spike in gateway-1 503s right after the 10% cut. Appears transient, investigating logs.

ben: logs snippet:
```
[14:02:12] gateway-1 ERROR upstream request failed code=503 route=/v1/generate id=9f2c
[14:02:12] router-edge canary: upstream conn reset during headers
```

alice: hold next step. Do not proceed to 30% until we confirm root cause. Reverting to 0% canary if it’s still degrading.

carmen: confirming pinned tenants still safe. No user-visible errors reported from acct-42.

samqa: replayed failing request against canary locally, saw header mismatch when X-Client-Version present. Might be header parsing change in v3.3.0.

ben: attempting quick mitigation: toggling header-strictness off on canary route to see if errors stop. Command: `rdctl router set router-edge-usw2-canary --header-strict=false`

deploy-bot: weight rollback initiated -> setting weight=0% for canary. (action id: edge-delta-190123-rollback)

deploy-bot: rollback complete. Traffic back to v3.2.0 (100%). All new canary instances drained.

ryan: monitoring — 5xx rate returned to baseline within 2m after rollback. No alert fires.

alice: thanks team. Decision: rollback confirmed, pin v3.2.0 for the remainder of the window, and open a follow-up infra ticket to fix header handling in v3.3.0.

ben: creating ticket INFR-224: "router: header parsing regression in v3.3.0 causing transient 503s on edge" and linking logs + repro.

carmen: removed temporary header toggle from staging. Will coordinate with release owner for a patched build.

samqa: will run a focused regression test matrix on Wed change window (10:00 PT) once patch is available.

alice: action items: 1) ben -> triage + patch. 2) samqa -> regression suite. 3) carmen -> keep tenant pins in place until patch validated. 4) ryan -> hold oncall for next attempt. We’ll reschedule. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deployment action closed (edge-delta-190123). Summary: canary triggered, rollback performed due to increased 5xx, traffic restored to v3.2.0.

alice: filing short note for release notes and for the ops runbook: add a preflight header-compatibility check to avoid repeat.

ben: ack.
